gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve all dynamic webhooks associated with my application to ensure they are correctly configured and functioning.
gold.ideal: The response should include a list of all dynamic webhooks, their IDs, URLs, and the events they are subscribed to.

gold.user: As an application administrator, I want to register new dynamic webhooks for my app so that I can receive event notifications from Jira.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the successful registration of the webhook and return the webhook ID and status.

gold.user: As a user, I want to delete a specific webhook that is no longer needed to clean up my application's configuration.
gold.ideal: The response should indicate that the webhook has been successfully deleted and return a success message.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to check for any failed webhooks to troubleshoot issues with event notifications.
gold.ideal: The response should provide a list of failed webhooks, including their IDs, error messages, and timestamps of the failures.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to refresh the webhooks to ensure they are up-to-date with the latest configuration changes.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm that the webhooks have been refreshed successfully and provide the updated status of each webhook.
